title: Smiling Young Girls in 1960s Skirts, 1963 Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A line of eight smiling young girls pose shoulder-to-shoulder outdoors before leafy trees and a suburban rooftop. Captured in 1963, as indicated by the photofinisher margin imprint, the girls showcase early 1960s American youth fashion, wearing high-waisted pleated and plaid skirts, pinafores with suspender straps, blouses, a striped knit top, and modest flats, with the girl on the far right standing barefoot. The photo reflects typical mid-century suburban childhood camaraderie and friendship.
